metadata.description: This week's Tribal Bulletin brings you all the essential news from Tribal India. In a tragic incident, two tribal women lost their lives after consuming mango kernels in Kandhamal. In Jharkhand, the political rivalry between the JMM and BJP intensifies, with debates surrounding Chief Minister Hemant Soren's age stirring further controversy. We also pay tribute to the legendary Gussadi dance master, Kanak Raju, whose legacy continues to inspire. Finally, we celebrate the vibrant Sohrai Festival, honouring traditional art and culture in tribal communities.
